headline: Google announces Gemini 4 Carbon with vendor-reported cybersecurity and long-horizon results
summary: Google announced Gemini 4 Carbon on Oct 28, 2026, with initial access for a subset of cyber defenders and broader access described as forthcoming. Google reports strong cybersecurity and agentic benchmark results and internal improvements in secure-code generation and alignment-related measures. At review time, Artificial Analysis lists Carbon at Intelligence Index 59 and the CWE-bench owner lists it at 71% deterministic pass@1 and 81% pass@4 over 120 private held-out tasks. Those leaderboard entries provide third-party benchmark-owner reporting, but this review did not inspect raw outputs or rerun either evaluation; SEC-bench Pro did not list Carbon and the linked ExploitGym repository was inaccessible. The announcement lists introductory API prices, but current public pricing docs did not show a Carbon SKU and no API access or billing was verified.
